document.abstract: Digital audio hardware is becoming more common in broadcasting. The need for an all-digital system that can successfully interface with different kinds of equipment is apparent. Since not all equipment is digital, however, a system that handles both high-quality analog and digital signals is needed. Synchronization and some possible digital switching topologies are discussed, and an advanced digital audio switching system for the AES/EBU digital audio standard is presented.
